rationale: The discourse has become highly structured and all sides now understand the trade-off, but the core incompatibility remains unresolved: labour and the state still reject closures/forced redundancies, while management, investors, and the family still insist on structural cost reduction and keep closures possible. The last two rounds mainly reiterated positions, with movement only toward a request for quantified scenarios rather than substantive convergence, so another ordinary round is unlikely to resolve the deadlock without external intervention or a formal scenario-based process.
